archive_member_counts: Each archive member has 0 hostile / 0 suspicious before and after; container retains 3 / 0.
upstream: Forager fetched official XMRig v6.25.0 Windows x64 ZIP and tagged source. Both native members compare byte for byte. Artifacts and .forage.json retained under scratch/d220-review/upstream.
reverse_engineering: Examined all 183 batch bytes: echo off, change to script directory, xmrig --url with fixed pool:443 and 95-character Monero wallet, --pass worker value, pause. No obfuscation or second-stage execution.
SFX at file offset 448000: Setup=1.bat and Silent=1. Three archive entries. 39315-byte postarchive tail verified entirely zero.
DriverEntry creates kernel device and symbolic link, installs IOCTL dispatch. 0x9c402084/0x9c402088 call RDMSR/WRMSR buffer routines at 0x11468/0x1149c.

Port-read path 0x11237 reads AX from DX then stores to [RCX]; 0x1132e loads a word from the input buffer then OUTs to DX. HAL calls at 0x112ec/0x11380 write/read bus configuration; ECX=4 selects PCI. New HAL matchers assert only bus configuration, not a specific bus.
IOCTL path 0x113b4 reaches physical BIOS-memory read at 0x11504. It bounds the physical range to 0xc0000..0xfffff, maps, copies to output, then unmaps. No arbitrary physical write inferred.

XMRig 0x14018cbe0 opens SCM and WinRing0. CreateServiceW at 0x14018d1b2 uses SERVICE_KERNEL_DRIVER=1 and SERVICE_DEMAND_START=3, followed by StartServiceW. Administrator failure is reported. This supports hardware tuning, not boot persistence or escalation.

XMRig generated-code allocation at 0x1400cf860 prepares local executable buffers. CRT IsDebuggerPresent callers are failure/exception paths. Retain capabilities without inferring injection or anti-analysis.
Tagged App.cpp checks configuration readiness before controller start; Stratum Client.cpp receives mining jobs and submits job results. MSR source agrees with recovered service and IOCTL constants.

Reviewed decoded-string candidates: 68 non-wide XMRig candidates (48 unicode-escape, 13 URL, six Base64, one hex) are ordinary diagnostic/source/format strings or decoder noise; no hidden command/payload recovered.
judgment_limits: The supplied launcher is customized with the payout wallet and selected for silent SFX execution, which tips it to malicious. Owner consent and the original lure are unavailable. The stock miner and signed vulnerable driver have legitimate purposes and are judged independently, preserving mining/MSR/driver findings.
coverage_gap: Launcher standalone remains 0 hostile / 0 suspicious: ten notable findings cover all its byte-supported behavior. Its unauthorized deployment/hidden activation is supplied by the enclosing SFX, whose three hostile traits are preserved. The launcher has no separate evasion, persistence, credential theft, download, or cleanup evidence from which to derive 3-5 distinct hostile traits. No matcher change can honestly make those claims from these standalone bytes.
classifier_gap: ML calibrated level remains -1/confidence 0 for all four artifacts, including the malicious launcher and confirmed archive. The archive has three hostile static findings. Engine warns that its feature spec is v18 while v21 is expected. No thresholds adjusted.
rendered_losses: Mapping finding moved, not removed. ExitThread still matches the new termination rule in explicit test-rules tracing; unreferenced baseline output is stripped. Any/needs-one unions are evaluated but filtered by the engine; explicit traces verified both kernel and allocation groups. Cached initial reports contained extra renderer-level findings; final before/after scans bypass caches with identical options.
